# Writing Plan — symb_invariant_consensus
# Generated: 2026-05-19T20:30:00Z
# Full Draft: Independence Bottleneck — "Fundamental Limitation" paper
# Target: EMNLP 2026 ARR May cycle
# Paper Agent Step 1 output

meta:
  venue: EMNLP 2026
  track: main (ARR May cycle)
  template: docs/paper/acl.sty
  template_note: "ACL/EMNLP shared template already in paper directory"
  page_limit: 8
  deadline: 2026-05-25
  title: >
    Beyond Self-Consistency: How Trace Independence Limits
    Symbolic Consensus in LLM Reasoning
  core_claim: >
    Same-model self-extraction of symbolic constraints inherits trace
    correlation (Fleiss' κ=0.21–0.82, Eff-K=1.20–3.62 for nominal K=12),
    creating a structural independence bottleneck. Oracle gold-FOL yields
    +14.22pp (p<0.001) proving aggregation is sound, but self-extraction
    captures only 24%. κ generalization across aggregation methods reveals
    a fundamental independence-accuracy trade-off: Debate reduces κ from
    0.44→0.15 (Eff-K 2→4.4) but collapses accuracy by -18.6pp. Same-model
    methods cannot increase independence without degrading the signal that
    makes aggregation useful.
  paper_type: "Fundamental limitation analysis (Condorcet framework + empirical diagnosis + 12 remediation failures)"
  framing: "Independence Bottleneck — structural limitation of same-model self-extraction"
  created_at: 2026-05-19T20:30:00Z

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Contributions (5)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
contributions:
  - id: C1
    label: "Independence Bottleneck Quantification"
    status: VERIFIED
    claim: >
      Fleiss' κ=0.21–0.82 (instruction-tuned), 0.91 (thinking mode).
      Eff-K=1.20–3.62 at K=12. Mistral 4-seed κ=0.41–0.51 (stable).
      Qwen Eff-K≈1.2–1.5 → near-zero Δ; Mistral PW Eff-K=3.62 but
      SC=39% → negative Δ. Dual requirement: sufficient Eff-K AND SC.
    evidence: "Table 3, §5.1"

  - id: C2
    label: "Oracle Gap Localizes Extraction Bottleneck"
    status: VERIFIED
    claim: >
      Gold FOL: +14.22pp FOLIO (p<0.001), +11.50pp PW (p<0.001).
      Self-extraction captures 24% of oracle ceiling (best seed +3.43pp
      vs +14.22pp). Aggregation mechanism sound; extraction quality is
      the binding bottleneck.
    evidence: "Table 1 oracle rows, §4.3"

  - id: C3
    label: "Regime-Dependent Effect with 4-Seed Replication"
    status: VERIFIED
    claim: >
      Intermediate-SC (~50–55%): best seed +3.43pp (p=0.092, ns);
      4-seed mean +1.47pp; 2/4 marginal (p<0.10), 0/4 significant.
      Type A (SC≥60%): 9 conditions N>2,800, no significant positive;
      significant negatives at -2.50pp (p=0.011) and -4.41pp (p=0.093).
      Type C (SC≤40%): -2.83pp (p=0.014).
    evidence: "Table 1, Figure 2, §4.1–4.3"

  - id: C4
    label: "Independence-Accuracy Trade-off Is Fundamental"
    status: VERIFIED
    claim: >
      κ generalization (exp-077) reveals why same-model methods must fail:
      SC κ=0.44 (Eff-K=2.02); Diverse-Prompt κ=0.40 (Eff-K=2.21, ≈SC);
      Debate κ=0.15 (Eff-K=4.44) but Δ=-18.6pp. Methods that increase
      independence (Debate) destroy accuracy; methods that preserve accuracy
      (ICG, Diverse-Prompt) cannot break correlation. 12 remediations
      (9 prompt + 3 method) all fail — not engineering failure but
      fundamental trade-off in same-model aggregation.
    evidence: "§5.6, Table T7 (κ generalization), method intervention table"

  - id: C5
    label: "Entropy Decomposition Reveals Regime Mechanism"
    status: VERIFIED
    claim: >
      Low-entropy: SICA≈SC across all 8 conditions (Δ≈0). High-entropy
      direction regime-dependent: +12.8pp intermediate-SC, -8.2pp Type A.
      Explains dual-channel mechanism (voting diversity + constraint
      homogenization).
    evidence: "§5.5, entropy analysis"

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Paper Outline
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
paper_outline:
  - section: abstract
    file: abstract.tex
    word_budget: 220
    core_bullets:
      - "Problem: SC (majority voting) plateaus; CJT explains why — traces lack independence"
      - "SICA pipeline evaluated across 6 models, 3 formal reasoning domains, N>3,000, 4-seed replication"
      - "Independence quantification: κ=0.21–0.82, Eff-K=1.20–3.62 at K=12"
      - "Regime: +3.43pp intermediate-SC (ns), -2.83pp Type C (p=0.014), ~0 Type A"
      - "Oracle +14.22pp/+11.50pp proves aggregation sound; self-extraction 24%"
      - "12 remediations (9 prompt + 3 method) all fail — bottleneck is structural"
      - "C0+SC zero-cost deployment diagnostic; paths forward require independence"
    dependencies: [experiments, analysis, method]

  - section: introduction
    file: introduction.tex
    word_budget: 1300
    core_bullets:
      - "Hook: Test-time compute scaling via SC improves reasoning—but plateaus. Adding more traces yields diminishing returns."
      - "Gap: Neuro-symbolic methods (Logic-LM, DyLoS, FoVer) improve reasoning with external/trained components. Can same-model self-extraction of formal constraints break the SC plateau without external tools?"
      - "Insight: CJT requires voter independence. Same-model traces violate this (Eff-K=1.20–3.62 for K=12). Self-extracted constraints inherit the correlation structure."
      - "Evaluation: SICA pipeline + Condorcet analysis + oracle control across 6 models × 3 domains, 4-seed replication"
      - "Key result: Oracle +14.22pp proves mechanism works; self-extraction captures 24%. 12 remediations all fail."
      - "Contributions: C1–C5"
    dependencies: [experiments, analysis]
    figures: [fig1_pipeline]
    citation_hints:
      - "SC: Wang et al. 2023"
      - "SC plateau: Loo et al. 2025"
      - "Logic-LM: Pan et al. 2023"
      - "DyLoS: Xu et al. 2026"
      - "CJT: Condorcet 1785, Ladha 1992"
      - "Self-correction parallel: Huang et al. 2024"

  - section: related_work
    file: related_work.tex
    word_budget: 750
    core_bullets:
      - "SC and extensions: Wang 2023, USC, weighted SC (Taubenfeld 2025), DiVeRSe, scaling plateaus (Loo 2025)"
      - "Neuro-symbolic reasoning: Logic-LM, LINC, DyLoS, Aristotle, FoVer — all use external/trained components; we test same-model self-extraction"
      - "Condorcet/voting theory: CJT, correlated voters (Ladha 1992), LLM ensembles (Lefort 2024 arXiv:2409.00094, closest prior work)"
      - "Verification and reranking: ORM (Cobbe 2021), PRM (Lightman 2023), Math-Shepherd — trained verifier paradigm"
      - "Self-X limitations: Huang 2024 self-correction ≈ structural parallel to self-extraction"
      - "Debate/multi-agent: Liang 2023, Du 2023 — different regime (multi-model or larger models)"
    dependencies: []

  - section: method
    file: method.tex
    word_budget: 1100
    subsections:
      - id: "sec:condorcet"
        title: "Self-Consistency and the Condorcet Independence Assumption"
        word_budget: 300
        bullets:
          - "SC as majority voting: sample K reasoning traces, select most common answer"
          - "CJT: K independent voters each with p>0.5 → P(majority correct) → 1 as K→∞"
          - "LLM traces violate independence: same model, same prompt, only sampling noise"
          - "Eff-K = K/(1+(K-1)κ) via Kish (1965) design effect; κ = Fleiss' kappa (1971)"
          - "When Eff-K≈1, additional traces ≈ no new information → SC plateau"
      - id: "sec:sica-pipeline"
        title: "SICA Pipeline"
        word_budget: 400
        bullets:
          - "Step 1: Generate K reasoning traces at temperature T"
          - "Step 2: Extract FOL constraints from each trace at T_ext=0.3"
          - "Step 3: Syntactic deduplication across traces"
          - "Step 4: Weighted partial MAX-SAT — hard clauses (answer assertion), soft clauses (constraints weighted by occurrence count)"
          - "Step 5: Z3 solver evaluates each candidate; answer with highest satisfiable weight selected"
          - "Timeout: 10s per candidate answer"
      - id: "sec:oracle-design"
        title: "Oracle Control Design"
        word_budget: 200
        bullets:
          - "Replace self-extracted constraints with gold FOL annotations (FOLIO) or gold DSL (ProofWriter)"
          - "Same Z3 evaluation pipeline; only constraint source changes"
          - "Causal intervention: isolates constraint quality from aggregation mechanism"
      - id: "sec:method-interventions"
        title: "Method-Level Interventions"
        word_budget: 150
        bullets:
          - "ICG: Generate constraints independently of traces (bypass trace-constraint coupling)"
          - "Contrastive: Pro/con constraint scoring per candidate answer"
          - "Debate: Proposer/Critic/Defense chain before constraint extraction"
          - "Each targets a different bottleneck aspect"
    dependencies: []
    figures: [fig1_pipeline]

  - section: experiments
    file: experiments.tex
    word_budget: 1800
    subsections:
      - id: "sec:exp-setup"
        title: "Experimental Setup"
        word_budget: 300
        bullets:
          - "6 models: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, Qwen3-14B (non-thinking), Qwen3-14B (thinking mode for κ analysis)"
          - "3 formal reasoning domains: FOLIO (n=204), ProofWriter depth-5 (n=600), LogiQA (n=200)"
          - "Cross-domain diagnostic: StrategyQA (n=200)"
          - "Degenerate probes: QwQ-32B (AIME 2024), Qwen2.5-14B (GSM8K)"
          - "Default: K=12, T=0.7, T_ext=0.3, Z3 timeout 10s"
          - "Metrics: accuracy (%), Δ=SICA−SC (pp), McNemar exact test α=0.05"
          - "4-seed replication on primary condition (Mistral-7B FOLIO)"
      - id: "sec:main-results"
        title: "Main Results: A Regime-Dependent Effect"
        word_budget: 500
        bullets:
          - "Table 1: ~18 conditions grouped by regime + 2 oracle rows"
          - "Intermediate-SC (SC~50–55%): Mistral FOLIO best seed +3.43pp (p=0.092 ns); 4-seed mean +1.47pp; Mistral LogiQA +0.50pp"
          - "Type A (SC≥60%): 9 conditions N>2,800; no significant positive effect"
          - "  Significant negatives: Qwen14B PW -2.50pp (p=0.011); Mistral PW -2.83pp (p=0.014)"
          - "  LLaMA FOLIO -4.41pp (p=0.093, marginal)"
          - "  Qwen3-14B FOLIO -0.49pp, PW +0.67pp — generational scaling does not help"
          - "Type C (SC≤40%): Mistral PW-D5 Δ=-2.83pp p=0.014 — SICA significantly hurts"
          - "Degenerate: C0<5% → SICA≡SC by construction"
          - "Figure 2: SC vs Δ scatter showing regime boundaries"
      - id: "sec:oracle"
        title: "Oracle Control: Aggregation Is Sound"
        word_budget: 250
        bullets:
          - "FOLIO: oracle-SICA 89.71% vs SC 75.49% (+14.22pp, p<0.001)"
          - "ProofWriter: oracle-SICA 86.67% vs SC 75.17% (+11.50pp, p<0.001)"
          - "Self-extraction captures only 24.1% of FOLIO oracle ceiling"
          - "Aggregation mechanism is sound; extraction quality is binding constraint"
      - id: "sec:replication"
        title: "Four-Seed Replication"
        word_budget: 250
        bullets:
          - "Mistral-7B FOLIO-204: seeds 42, 123, 456, 789"
          - "s42: Δ=+3.43pp p=0.092; s123: +2.94pp p=0.070; s456: 0.00pp p=1.0; s789: -0.49pp p=1.0"
          - "2/4 marginal positive (p<0.10); 0/4 reaches p<0.05"
          - "4-seed mean: +1.47pp; range: +3.43 to -0.49"
          - "Fragility itself is the finding — motivates independence analysis"
      - id: "sec:failure-modes"
        title: "Failure Mode Analysis"
        word_budget: 250
        bullets:
          - "Type A: consistent traces → constraints mirror model's answers → MAX-SAT degenerates to counting"
          - "Type B: domain not formalizable (LogiQA contradiction rate 0.8%)"
